title: Successive local quotients of a relative global complete intersection are flat over the base
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $P=R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ be a polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and let $f_1,\dots,f_c\in P$. Suppose $S=P/(f_1,\dots,f_c)$ is a relative global complete intersection over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-relative-global-complete-intersection]. For every prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset S$, let $\mathfrak q'$ be its inverse image in $P$; for each $0\le i\le c$, the ring $P_{\mathfrak q'}/(f_1,\dots,f_i)P_{\mathfrak q'}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is flat as an $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00SV (lemma-relative-global-complete-intersection-conormal), part (2), algebra.tex lines 36767-36820

proof.text: For a Noetherian coefficient ring and a polynomial prime Q containing the full equation ideal, let p be its contraction to the base. The canonical map R_p -> R[x]_Q is flat and local by polynomial freeness and RingHom.Flat.localRingHom. Use the existing closed-fibre regularity theorem, then the prefix-flatness conclusion of Grothendieck regular-sequence lifting. Restrict scalars from R_p to R using Module.flat_iff_of_isLocalization; the localRingHom_to_map identity supplies the scalar tower. This is the private Lean helper noetherian_prefix_flat.

Contract the given quotient prime to Q in R[x]. Each equation lies in Q because its image in the quotient is zero. Noetherian approximation supplies R0 and f0; coefficient extensionality identifies f with the coefficientwise inclusion of f0.

For each finite type integer subring B containing R0, use the inclusion algebra R0 -> B. The ring B is Noetherian, and relative-complete-intersection base change gives the specified presentation fB. Composition of coefficient maps identifies its full equation ideal with equations lying in the contracted prime Q_B. Apply the Noetherian helper at Q_B and the given index i to obtain the stage flatness hypothesis of polynomial-local-flat-quotient-descent.

The generic polynomial-local-flat-quotient-descent theorem now gives flatness of the localized prefix list quotient over R. The elements of List.take i (List.ofFn f) are exactly f_j with j.val < i, even when equations repeat; Ideal.map_ofList and List.map_take identify its ideal with the mapped span in the unchanged conclusion.

split_report.summary: Followed the proof of part (2) of Stacks 00SV (algebra.tex 36783-36832). Noetherian case (Steps 1-3): R_p -> P_q' is a flat local map of Noetherian local rings (P free, Hilbert basis, 00HT); the f_j are a regular sequence in P_q'/pP_q' (fibre ring = k[x], 00SS(1) over k=kappa(p) gives fibre dimension n-c, then the regular-sequence lemma of 00SB/00SC, transported by the natural isomorphism of 0H9M); 00MG gives flatness over R_p, then over R. General case (Steps 4-7): Noetherian approximation 00SU, directed family of finite type Z-subrings, base change 00SS(1), the colimit identification written out, and 05UU(2) in the form of a directed union of subrings. New nodes: 00MG, 00SS(1), 00SU, 05UU(2) (subring form), and the natural-map form of 0H9M (the existing node lem-weil-pbc-fibre-ring-local-ring-iso states only an abstract isomorphism). Citer lem-weil-pbc-relative-global-complete-intersection-flat uses i=c; formulation matches. Statement unchanged.
